title: HNSW 图结构模拟：分层下降路径 vs 暴力检索
expected_output:
HNSW 分层数 = 6
HNSW 访问节点数 = 20
HNSW 跳数 = 41
暴力检索访问节点数 = 20
HNSW 与暴力 最近节点一致 = True
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
P = 20
D = 4
vecs = rng.standard_normal((P, D))
q = rng.standard_normal(D)

layers = []
layer = list(range(P))
while len(layer) > 1:
    layers.append(layer)
    layer = layer[::2]
layers.append(layer)

visited = set()
hops = 0
cur = layers[-1][0]
for layer in reversed(layers):
    best = None
    best_d = None
    for node in layer:
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(q - vecs[node]))
        visited.add(node)
        hops += 1
        if best_d is None or d < best_d:
            best_d = d
            best = node
    cur = best

brute_visited = 0
best_b = None
best_bd = None
for node in range(P):
    brute_visited += 1
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(q - vecs[node]))
    if best_bd is None or d < best_bd:
        best_bd = d
        best_b = node

print('HNSW 分层数 =', len(layers))
print('HNSW 访问节点数 =', len(visited))
print('HNSW 跳数 =', hops)
print('暴力检索访问节点数 =', brute_visited)
print('HNSW 与暴力 最近节点一致 =', cur == best_b)
